videos.title: Puppy Swap: Love Unleashed
videos.description: An engaged couple adopts two puppies. When they decide to split up, the puppies hatch a plan to bring the two back together.

videos.title: Paws P.I.
videos.description: A boy recruits his talking dog and parrot to help him take down a tyrannical tycoon who's determined to stop a local mansion from being turned into an animal rescue.

videos.title: Pups United
videos.description: A group of talking dogs team up to save the Youth World Cup soccer finals.

videos.title: The Shortcut
videos.description: Children grow up avoiding a path after kids go missing near a creepy old man's house. Now high school seniors, they decide to find out what the shovel-wielding weirdo is hiding.

videos.title: Chappaquiddick
videos.description: On July 18, 1969, Sen. Ted Kennedy drives his car off of a bridge on Massachusetts' Chappaquiddick Island. The accident results in the death of passenger Mary Jo Kopechne, a 28-year-old campaign strategist who worked for Kennedy. The ongoing investigation into the mysterious and scandalous events forever alters Kennedy's political legacy -- and ultimately changes the course of presidential history.

videos.title: All Is Lost
videos.description: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner (Robert Redford) awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.

videos.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
videos.description: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

videos.title: The Winning Season
videos.description: Increasingly estranged from his own daughter, a boozy busboy (Sam Rockwell) gets a shot at redemption when an old friend (Rob Corddry) hires him to coach a varsity girls basketball team.

videos.title: Lulu on the Bridge
videos.description: A seemingly magic stone leads an aging, injured musician (Harvey Keitel) into love with a young, aspiring actress (Mira Sorvino).

videos.title: Love Me
videos.description: A teen (Lindsey Shaw) begins a romance with a new student (Jamie Johnston) who becomes a suspect in the disappearance of a girl (Kristina Elliott).

videos.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
videos.description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

videos.title: The Honor List
videos.description: Four girls sink a time capsule in a lake with a list of things they want to do before graduation, but they all go separate ways before graduating. When a tragedy strikes, they reunite to find the capsule and complete the bucket list.

videos.title: Fisherman's Friends: One and All
videos.description: Following the unexpected success of their debut album, members of the musical group Fisherman's Friends struggle with the pressures, pitfalls and temptations of their newfound fame.

videos.description: Jack lives in a national park with his mom, dad and dog Ranger, and when he meets Chloe, the two become fast friends. When Jack finds a treasure map, he and Chloe are kidnapped by robbers, and only Ranger can save the day.

videos.title: Powder Pup
videos.description: Shaun is a 16-year-old Southern California surfer, who hates his dad's plan to move to mountains of Montana, until he meets a dog who can snowboard. With the help of his canine friend, he is set to make a run for the annual snowboarding championship.

videos.title: Bart Got a Room
videos.description: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein, a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

videos.title: Girl in Progress
videos.description: Grace is a single mom who is often too busy juggling her job, bills and two love interests to pay much attention to her daughter, Ansiedad. Inspired by the coming-of-age stories her English teacher introduces in class, Ansiedad decides to skip adolescence and jump-start her life without her mother. But, when the misguided plan unravels, Ansiedad and Grace must both learn that growing up means acting your age.

videos.description: In the present, artist Tom Warshaw recalls his traumatic coming of age. As a 13-year-old growing up in New York City in 1973, Tom hangs out with Pappass, a mentally disabled man. With Tom's mother battling depression after the death of her husband, the young boy is left to his own devices. When Tom develops a crush on schoolmate Melissa, Pappass feels abandoned and begins behaving erratically.

videos.title: The Adventures of Marco Polo
videos.description: The medieval Italian trader/traveler (Don Diamont) journeys to Central Asia and China, where he meets Kublai Khan.
